title: Llama
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- backgroundless llama -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d2a8'/>
  <rect x='59' y='72' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d2a8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 50 Q64 30 58 18 L70 18 Q74 34 72 52 Z' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='16' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='6' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f4e3c1' transform='rotate(-15 57 6)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='6' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f4e3c1' transform='rotate(15 74 6)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='7' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e88da6' transform='rotate(-15 57 7)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='7' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e88da6' transform='rotate(15 74 7)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='21' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffeccc'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='14' r='2.2' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='14' r='2.2' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='63.7' cy='13.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='72.7' cy='13.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='1' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='20' r='1' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M68 24 Q72 26 76 24' stroke='#b98a5a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='56' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e8d2a8'/>
  <!-- fluffy chest detail -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
